verdict.rationale: Typesense's open-source server is GPL-3.0 and exposes the complete API surface. The docs say it can be self-hosted free forever and run locally or on any server. They document Docker, Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, DEB/RPM, Linux binaries, WSL, Terraform and Docker Swarm, plus production best-practices guidance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments (community comments only praise the C++ codebase or plan to try it as a lighter docker-compose option).
